asked.item: Why does my 8-image Pinterest carousel fail?
Is a carousel with 8 images allowed for Pinterest?

verdict.reason: The help pages state the Pinterest carousel image range and that the publisher rejects more than 5 media items, which explains the failure for an 8-image carousel.

steps.text: A Pinterest carousel can use 2–5 images.
The publisher rejects more than 5 media items, so a Pinterest carousel with more than 5 images fails.
